senses.gloss:
ITA-1.2.3 ahitāyuḥ अहितायुः
Unsalutary life
A mode of life that is disadvantageous for oneself and generally detrimental.

ITA-9.3.2 ahitebhyoarthebhyomanonigraha अहितेभ्योऽर्थेभ्योमनोनिग्रह
Restraining the mind from unwholesome desires
The key method of satvavajaya-cikitsā is to restrain the mind from unwholesome desires and unnecessary engagement with sensory objects.

ITA-5.71.7 ahipūtana अहिपूतन
Napkin rash
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: itching; sudden appearance of blisters; secretion from vesicles on itching; worsening of lesion on merging. A disorder that is generally due to unhygienic conditions or napkin allergy.

ITA-5.62.39 ahipūtanakaḥ अहिपूतनकः
Napkin rash
A disorder characterized by itching in the anal region; sudden appearance of blisters; secretion from vesicles on scratching; dreadful lesion when coalescent.
